user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features and answers.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and compliance of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits pages submitted as ads; not used for model training.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content to train OpenAI generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform user-triggered actions and fetch web pages in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated actions and interactions with external applications via GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply to user-initiated actions.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to potentially contribute to AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content gathered for generative AI model development.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt for User-agent: ClaudeBot.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites in response to user queries to Claude.
user_agents.scope: Retrieves web content at users' direction during Claude interactions.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt for User-agent: Claude-User.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to enhance search result quality and relevance.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content for user search optimization.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt for User-agent: Claude-SearchBot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Find information for building Google's search indexes and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Video mode, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images for Google products and features.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Video mode, and Search features presenting images, logos, and favicons.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Googlebot-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl videos for video-related Google Search features.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Googlebot-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for the Google News product.
user_agents.scope: Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Googlebot-News in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl pages for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping, including the Shopping tab in Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Storebot-Google in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Crawl pages for Search testing tools.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and URL inspection in Search Console.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Google-InspectionTool in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible content for internal research, development, and product teams.
user_agents.scope: Non-product-specific crawls and internal research and development.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible image URLs for Google product teams.
user_agents.scope: Optimized image fetching without affecting specific Google products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GoogleOther-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible video URLs for Google product teams.
user_agents.scope: Optimized video fetching without affecting specific Google products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GoogleOther-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content requested by site owners for Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Google-CloudVertexBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Manage content usage for Gemini model training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Training Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Google-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology and context for AI features across Apple products.
user_agents.scope: Webpages crawled for Spotlight, Siri, Safari, and Apple ecosystem features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use noindex robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls training of Apple foundation models powering generative AI features.
user_agents.scope: Determines usage of Applebot crawled data for training generative foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in the robots.txt file.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawl app or website content shared on Meta apps.
user_agents.scope: Gathers, caches, and displays information like title, description, and thumbnail image.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt; may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance relevance and accuracy of Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improve advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content to improve advertising and business products.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Train foundation AI models or improve products by indexing content.
user_agents.scope: Crawls the web for training AI models and indexing content.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetch links at user request and improve agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Fetches user-requested links and helps AI navigate websites to complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt because fetches are requested by users.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve products and services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls host-level web content to provide customer information and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt allow/disallow directives and noarchive, noindex, or none meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences in Amazon products and services.
user_agents.scope: Content eligibility for search experiences such as Alexa; excludes generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt directives for Amzn-SearchBot or directives given to other search bots.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions such as responding to Alexa queries.
user_agents.scope: Fetches live information from the web on behalf of users; excludes AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives because actions are initiated by users.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Automated web crawler providing a copy of the Internet for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Crawl candidate pages from database, following links to create open web dataset.
user_agents.opt_out: Add 'User-agent: CCBot' and 'Disallow: /' to robots.txt, or join opt-out registry.
